title: Homes view path step 1
what: Tap→render trace step 1: **Mandala (LivingMandalaView).** The first tap on a seat flies to it and shows `SignificanceCard`, which offers "know her ›" and **"be with her ›"** (`Views/Mandala/SignificanceCard.swift:109-121`; `LivingMandalaView.swift:297-303`). A **second tap on the focused seat** opens `ShaktiDetailView` in a full-screen cover (`LivingMandalaView.swift:566-571, 202-203`). Tapping ring 9 (kp 102) opens the Mandala's Bindu descent instead (`:568`), so the DissolveRoom is never reached from the Mandala seat tap.
notes: Design meant the room to be the Home and the Detail the library beneath it.

title: Homes view path step 2

title: Homes · why it looks basic (a)
what: The default landing is the Presence page (ShaktiDetailView), with the Home behind a text link.

title: Homes · why it looks basic (b)
what: Inside the Home, the mechanism layer may only dent three dark stone surfaces (ink at l = 12 %) at 64², so the authored rooms' luminous geometry (Design measured rooms at 80–255 luminance) is reduced to relief raked by one key.

title: Homes · why it looks basic (c)
what: The R-09 saturated light room never existed in Swift.

title: Homes · why it looks basic (d)
what: Reduce motion freezes the room at its end state, so on a device with Reduce Motion on the room never adapts at all.
